hero.headline: Building things that work, and work well
hero.sub: I'm Rudolf Garcia — a web developer who also builds 3D web environments and automates workflows behind the scenes. I care about clean interfaces, reliable back-end plumbing, and code that's easy to hand off. Currently building at

projects.title: Virtual Biobank — 3D Specimen Digitization
projects.description: A web-based virtual biobank for insect specimens: photogrammetry scans turned into interactive 3D models, viewable in an A-Frame environment with HTML/CSS wireframes for the walkthrough and navigation.

projects.title: WordPress & Elementor Client Sites
projects.description: Built and maintained client websites on WordPress/Elementor, including SMTP email configuration and PayPal payment integration, plus ongoing updates and maintenance.

projects.title: RCEF Utilization Monitoring System
projects.description: An Excel-based monitoring system for farm machinery utilization reports from 67 provinces — VBA macros and formulas handle data cleaning, table organizing, and report consolidation from raw submissions.

paragraphs: I'm an IT graduate who works across web development, 3D digitization, and workflow automation. Right now I'm a Science Research Analyst building a virtual biobank — digitizing specimens through photogrammetry and building the 3D web environments that display them.

Before that, I built WordPress sites for clients and handled everything from payment integration to email setup. I like picking up new tools quickly, and I'm just as comfortable behind a spreadsheet automating a report as I am behind a code editor.

footer.heading: Let's build something.
